svg.desc: Neon market: a rain-slicked cyberpunk bazaar of stacked neon stalls under a tangle of cables, with the park's colossal tree traced in neon on the skyline, a warm passage back to the hub at the lower left, an open plaza on the right where the giant robot owl rises behind the railing, and a cozy gift-shop kiosk near the middle. Original placeholder art for Owl Park.
